name: OK-VQA: Outside Knowledge Visual Question Answering
description: OK-VQA is a visual question-answering benchmark requiring external world knowledge beyond image contents to answer. Presented at CVPR 2019 by Allen Institute for AI, it features 14,055 questions covering 14,031 images from MS COCO, spanning 11 knowledge categories including history, science, geography, and culture.
